title.en: From Sample Room to Bulk Production

body.en: Children’s and teen thermal sets developed from sample to bulk, with real products and manufacturing spaces shown throughout the site.

question.en: Which products does XIONGBA currently offer?

answer.en: The launch catalogue has four thermal underwear sets for children and teens. Each product page shows the intended wearer, fabric, fit and supplied imagery.

question.en: Can I see garment details before I send an inquiry?

answer.en: Yes. Product pages show full-garment, model and construction-detail images where supplied.

question.en: Which parts of a garment can be customised?

answer.en: Size, fabric, colour, print, binding and construction can be reviewed against your brief.

question.en: Can I work from my own design or reference garment?

answer.en: Yes. Send design materials or a reference garment, or start from a listed model and discuss changes.

question.en: What are the MOQ, sample fee and lead time?

answer.en: These depend on the selected style, fabric, colour and print, so they are confirmed after the RFQ is reviewed.

question.en: How does the sample-to-bulk process work?

answer.en: Share a brief, review fit and fabric, develop and approve a sample, then prepare bulk production, inspection and packing.

question.en: What checks are made during production?

answer.en: Checkpoints cover material intake, cutting and sewing, garment inspection and packing.

question.en: What should I include in an RFQ?

answer.en: Include your company, business email, product interest and requirements. Quantity, target market and contact number help us respond more precisely.

question.en: How can I reach the team?

answer.en: Use the RFQ form or email info@xiongbafushi.com with your requirements and reference images.

description.en: Explore children’s and teen thermal sets, OEM/ODM options, real product imagery and the sample-to-bulk process from XIONGBA.
